crossRefs.note: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
“ ‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That…
Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity…

translations.web: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
translations.bsb: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will no longer behave arrogantly.
translations.kjv: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
translations.asv: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
